summary: QIAGEN N.V. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its unaudited U.S. GAAP quarterly report for the period ended September 30, 2026, signed by CFO Roland Sackers on November 5, 2026. The exhibit comprises condensed consolidated balance sheets, income and cash-flow statements, notes, operating review, market-risk disclosures and legal proceedings. No transaction, corporate action, board recommendation, advisor or special-situation term is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary periodic foreign-private-issuer report. Watch items are limited to balance-sheet trends, including cash of $805.1 million, debt of roughly $1.64 billion and lower share count from buybacks.
